description_en: Queries the daily traffic for a single card
name: ListCardDayUsages

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G Cloud Connector instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifiers (ICCIDs) of the Internet of Things (IoT) SIM cards. You can specify up to 50 ICCIDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 物联网SIM卡卡号，每次最大50条
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en: The number of recent months for which to query traffic data. The default value is 2, which includes the current month. The value can range from 1 to 6
parameters.help_zh: 查询最近几个月卡流量数据，默认两个月，包含当月。参数范围[1,6]
parameters.name: latest_month_num
